name: Integrated Program in Biomedical Sciences (IPBS) PhD
summary: Integrated PhD program at Loyola's Stritch School of Medicine. Students are admitted to IPBS and choose a dissertation advisor and one of six tracks by the end of the first year.

deadlines.label: Application deadline (Fall 2027)
deadlines.note: The page says "The deadline to apply for the PhD program for Fall 2027 is Tuesday, December 1, 2026." No time is given. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and early applications are encouraged.

timeline.interviews: An in-person interview is required. Interviews take place between January and March of the admission year.

english.note: TOEFL or IELTS scores are required for international applicants. No minimum scores are given on the page read.

applicationFee.note: The page says applications are submitted online only and there is no fee to apply.

documents: Transcripts for all undergraduate and graduate work
Declaration and Certification of Finances form (international applicants)
Evaluation of international transcripts by a NACES member (international applicants)

funding.note: The page says the current stipend for PhD students is $34,000 per year (no year stated) and that PhD students also receive a full tuition scholarship for 48 credit hours. It does not say whether this covers international students.
